info.name: Leapcure Blog Content API (WordPress REST API) categories users API

description.content:
Public content API for the Leapcure blog (blog.leapcure.com), served by the WordPress REST API `wp/v2` namespace. Read operations on posts, pages, categories, tags, users, media, comments, search, taxonomies, types and statuses were verified to respond anonymously on 2026-07-19; write operations require authentication via WordPress application passwords. This document was derived by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline from the route metadata the server itself publishes at https://blog.leapcure.com/wp-json/wp/v2 — no operations, parameters or schemas were invented.
